role: probabilities of the four astragalus outcomes, indexed by score
notes: Durrett p. 3 notation; nonnegative weights summing to one on the outcome set {1,3,4,6}.

role: abbreviation for: X is F-measurable (sigma(X) contained in F)
notes: Durrett p. 10 and p. 215. Not set membership: X is a function. Agrees with ordinary membership on indicators by thm:p15-w02c-p15-002-indicator-membership. Target sigma-algebra fixed by context.

role: extended real line [-infinity,infinity] with its order topology
notes: Durrett p. 17 notation; same ordered set as the handbook's overline R of def:p15-extended-random-variables. Distinct glyph from the relation-closure star R^* registered in Parts 1, 8 and 12.

role: Borel sigma-algebra of the order topology of the extended real line
notes: Durrett p. 17; equals sigma([-infinity,a], a real) by thm:p15-w02c-p15-002-order-borel.

role: set of outcomes where lim X_n exists as a real number
notes: Durrett p. 16 symbol; read with a real limit here. The set with limit in the extended line is written out as {liminf = limsup}.

role: the convention limsup_n X_n for a sequence of real random variables
notes: Durrett p. 17; extended real random variable, possibly infinite, equal to the limit on Omega_o.

role: trace sigma-algebra {A in F : A subset of D} on an event D
notes: Handbook notation for the source's random variables defined on D in F (Durrett p. 17).

role: extension of a random variable on D by the constant value c off D
notes: Local to the lemma; superscript c is a constant in the extended line, not a complement.

role: nice map: one-to-one measurable map into R with measurable inverse on its image
notes: Durrett p. 53 letter; the definition is def:p15-w02c-p15-004-nice, used unchanged. Also used in sec:p15-w02c-p15-002-nice-rcd. In def:p15-w02c-p15-002-borel-paradox the same letter is Durrett's latitude (p. 210); the scopes do not meet.

role: longitude and latitude (or angle along the great circle) of a random point on the sphere
notes: Durrett p. 210 notation; the handbook's random coordinates are Theta, Phi and Theta', Psi of def:p15-sphere-coordinate-law.

role: chosen version of P(X in A | G) for a measurable set A
notes: Local to the lemma and its annex proof.

role: intervals [-infinity,a), (a,b), (b,infinity] of the extended line, and those with rational endpoints
notes: Annex-local base of the order topology.

role: signed sum of F over the vertices of the finite rectangle A
notes: Durrett p. 7 notation; equals mu(A) when F is the distribution function of mu (thm:p15-w02c-p15-002-rectangle-inclusion-exclusion).

role: vertex set of a finite rectangle and the sign (-1)^(number of lower endpoints) of a vertex
notes: Durrett p. 7 notation; local to the definition of Delta_A F.

role: strong tail condition: F tends to 0 as any one coordinate tends to -infinity, and to 1 as all tend to infinity
notes: Handbook label for the corrected form of Durrett's condition (iii), p. 7.

role: difference operator in coordinate k between s and t
notes: Annex-local; composition over all coordinates gives Delta_A F (display dagger).

role: equality in distribution (same law)
notes: Durrett pp. 11-12; the subscript form is his in-text variant. Same glyph already listed for P15 weak-convergence-of-laws with the same meaning.

role: subspace phi^{-1}(E) of a nice space carried by a Borel set E, with its trace sigma-algebra
notes: Annex-local.

role: the split set in (0,1), the sigma-algebra generated by F_U and H_U, and the probability extending U with P_H(B cap H_U)=U(B)/2
notes: Notation of sec:p15-w02c-p15-008-no-rcp (thm:p15-w02c-p15-008-thick-set, def:p15-w02c-p15-008-model), used unchanged with the same meaning.

role: Durrett's inverse of a distribution function: u mapsto sup{y : F(y) < u} for 0<u<1
notes: Durrett p. 11 notation; the same map as Q_F of def:p15-quantile-map (registered for sec:p15-measure-extension) and the same meaning as F^{-1} registered for sec:p15-weak-convergence-of-laws. F need not be one-to-one or onto.

role: Durrett's notation for the distribution of X: A mapsto P(X^{-1}(A))
notes: Durrett sec. 1.2, Figure 1.3, p. 10; equals the law P_X of def:p15-pushforward-law. X^{-1} is the preimage map on sets, not an inverse function.

role: enumeration of the rationals and the positive weights (summing to one) placed on them
notes: Durrett Example 1.2.9, p. 14 notation; local to the example and thm:p15-w02c-p15-002-dense-jumps.

role: indicator of the closed ray [theta, infinity)
notes: Durrett p. 14 writes 1_[theta,infinity); same indicator notation as def:p15-simple-functions.

role: Borel sigma-algebra of the real line and of R^d
notes: Reuse of the meaning registered for P15 measurable-probability; used in body and annex of this chapter.

role: sub-sigma-algebra of the probability space (conditioning sigma-algebra); in annex:p15-w02c-p15-002-generator-variants the generated sigma-algebras G_1, G_2 compared with the Borel sets
notes: Reuse of the meaning registered for P15 conditional-expectation; the annex-local G_1, G_2 are generated sigma-algebras.

role: target measurable space of a random element; in annex:p15-w02c-p15-002-rd-construction S_n is the semialgebra of finite rectangles in the box B_n
notes: Durrett p. 10 letter; same meaning as registered for P15 countable-product-measures. The annex-local S_n is a semialgebra, as in thm:p15-semialgebra-extension.

role: algebra generated by the semialgebra S_n
notes: Annex-local; the generated algebra of thm:p15-semialgebra-extension.

role: probability measure (on the astragalus outcomes); P_X the law of a random variable X
notes: Reuse of the meanings registered for P15 measurable-probability (P_X as in def:p15-pushforward-law).

role: measurable space of a conditioning random element Y
notes: Local letter for the codomain of Y in thm:p15-w02c-p15-002-nice-rcd and its annex proof; not a topology.
